argument:
Costco grew FY26 net sales 10.1% to $297.2bn and net income to $9.226bn from $8.099bn. Adjusted annual comparable sales of 6.6% give the bullish case evidence beyond scale or a one-off quarterly EPS boost. Continued operating execution could support a durable consumer exposure if demand and profitability remain resilient.

The 44.49x snapshot trailing P/E requires a high standard of sustained growth; no fair value or margin of safety is established. Q4 EPS includes a nonrecurring $0.15 tariff-refund benefit, and the net-income/net-sales ratio excludes membership fees from its denominator. Price is still below SMA-200 despite an improving rebound, with overbought RSI and weak volume. The defensible case is long-term operating quality with valuation discipline, not an immediate breakout purchase.
key_points: Annual sales, earnings and adjusted comparables improved.
Tariff refunds and denominator differences must not inflate quality claims.
Premium valuation and incomplete trend recovery favor disciplined entry.
